title: Positive lower density of large prime gaps
summary: For every fixed C > 0, we prove that a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed $`C\log p`$, where p is the smaller prime. The proportion is bounded below for every sufficiently large initial segment of the prime sequence, with a constant depending on C . It follows that the indices at which $`p_n/n`$ increases have positive lower asymptotic density, answering a question of Erdős and Prachar.
